name: @technway/layout-kit
description: A lightweight and modular CSS utility framework focused on creating responsive grid systems and flexible layouts for modern web design.
author: Technway <contact@technway.biz>

scripts.clean: rmdir /s /q dist 2>nul || echo Dist directory not found
scripts.build: pnpm clean && pnpm type-check && pnpm build:ts && pnpm build:react && pnpm copy:css && pnpm copy:css
scripts.build:layout-kit: pnpm clean && pnpm type-check && pnpm build:ts && pnpm build:react && pnpm copy:css && pnpm copy:css
scripts.copy:css: mkdir dist\css 2>nul || echo dist\css exists && (if exist src\css\grid.css (copy /Y src\css\grid.css dist\css\grid.css) else (copy /Y src\grid.css dist\css\grid.css))
